name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success & Account Analytics | Agency Partnerships

Retained ~94% of a 15-20 reseller partner book at Birdeye, built reporting frameworks on ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion at Level Agency, and runs Google Ads and paid campaigns hands-on. Turns data from multiple sources into clear recommendations using Excel, Power BI, GA4, HubSpot, and Claude, and keeps account data clean and current.
